description: Pinned tool versions in Ansible files. GitHub Actions stay with Dependabot (actions.lock), and Ansible collections follow Homebrew's ansible.

customManagers.description: k3s, from the stable channel (the latest stable release; it can be more than one minor ahead)

packageRules.description: A checksum pinned next to the version must be updated by hand; open these PRs as drafts so they cannot be merged before that
prBodyNotes: Renovate does not update the SHA-256 pinned next to this version, and CI does not download anything, so a stale checksum passes CI and only fails when the playbook runs. Update it on this branch with the `update-versions` skill (see AGENTS.md), then mark the PR ready for review.

packageRules.description: hishtory is skipped on Macs that already have it, so a stale checksum would go unnoticed there
prBodyNotes: The playbook skips hishtory on Macs that already have it, so this version and its checksum are only exercised on a fresh Mac. Existing Macs update with `hishtory update`.

packageRules.description: k3s changes the live cluster: one minor at a time, servers before agents, backup first
prBodyNotes: Applying this restarts the live cluster. Check that it stays within the current minor or moves to the next one; if the stable channel is two or more minors ahead, change it to the latest patch of the next minor first (Kubernetes does not support skipping a minor). Take a backup (`--tags backup`), upgrade the servers first (`--limit k3s_server`), then the agents.
